_comment: Per-address overrides for the paired-runtime return comparison. The default criterion is the set of return-value classes each image produced. That is only a valid criterion when a native's return class does not depend on which call it is; for a lookup whose result depends on its arguments the two independently timed runs make different calls, so class-set equality is meaningless. Each override records why, and the emitted report then states reachability as its basis instead of implying a return-value agreement.

0x00517890.reason: Iff_FindFormChunk walks a chunk tree and returns the node whose tag matches the argument, or null when the tag is absent. The class of the return therefore depends on the tag searched for and on the tree contents, and the two runs made different calls (retail 406, candidate 18), so comparing the class sets would be comparing two different call samples. The paired observation still proves the native was reached in both images; it does not prove equal return values.

0x004CF080.reason: DynObj_LoadModelTexturePackage leaves a path-dependent value in EAX: its only return (0x004CF2F2) is reached after loop counters are decremented, and the live paired capture observed a null return on the shipped data while the empty-fixture differential (scripts/mtp_package_diff_runner.py) observes a non-null value for the same entry. The return is therefore not a stable contract to compare across two independently timed runs; the paired observation still proves the native was reached in both images.

0x004C5F00.reason: the native's return value is the value left by its tail call to Resource_Unload (0x004B6380), which returns a resource-cache bookkeeping value: the entry's kind at +0x??, or the freed-memory amount from the allocator hook (resource_lifecycle.cpp). The port reads TERRAIN.LMP directly through its host adapter and keeps no such cache entry, so this value measures the cache implementation rather than the native's behaviour. The captured values (retail 10, candidate 1) are consistent with that: neither is a count of the ten lightmap pages the native actually loads.

0x004AD73D.reason: the return value is the uppercased form of the character passed in, so its class is the class of whichever character the caller sampled. The two runs call the native with different characters (retail 1,443,586 calls across level load, the candidate one deliberate call), so comparing class sets would compare two different samples. The paired observation still proves the native was reached in both images and that the ported body ran; it does not prove equal outputs.

0x004B5B30.reason: the return value is a hash of the path argument, so its class is the class of whichever path was hashed. The two runs hash different paths, so class-set equality is not a meaningful criterion; the paired observation proves only that both images reached the native.

0x00463180.reason: retail 0x00463180 is `mov eax,[esp+4]; mov al,[eax+0x33d]; ret`: it returns the human pointer with its low byte replaced by the crouch flag, so EAX still carries the caller's pointer bits and the class reflects the caller's data rather than a value the native computes. The port returns the flag byte as std::uint8_t; callers read AL only, which is equivalent. Class-set equality is therefore not a behavioural criterion here, only reachability.

0x00465820.reason: retail 0x00465820 writes the eye vector into the caller's output buffer and never assigns EAX on any path, so the observed return is whatever its last `mov eax,[edi+0x2c]` copied out of the human record - caller data, not a result. The ported body is void for the same reason. Only reachability is meaningful.

0x00402800.reason: retail 0x00402800 pushes its argument and calls QTask_RegisterInputPortHandler, then returns without assigning EAX, so the observed return is whatever the callee left there - not a value this native computes. The ported body is void for the same reason; reachability is the only meaningful criterion.

0x004BD3D0.reason: retail 0x004BD3D0 stores the handler pointer into the opcode handler table and returns without writing EAX, so the observed class is callee residue rather than a result. The ported body is void; only reachability is meaningful.

0x004B7540.reason: retail 0x004B7540 writes its two out-parameters and returns without assigning any observable value of its own; EAX still holds whatever the last 'mov eax,[esp+8]' left there. The ported body is void, so only reachability is a meaningful criterion.
